answer: Price identity instead of granting it, and a sybil farm starves. Require each newcomer to be sponsored by an incumbent who escrows a bond, forfeited the moment the recruit double-votes. Sponsorship becomes the scarce good: minting a thousand puppets means staking a thousand bonds, a cost curve nobody dodges. Think of a crystal under pressure, every lattice point locked to its neighbours, so no counterfeit layer slips in without fracturing the structure. Trust becomes a narrow ledge rather than a wide canyon of anonymous entrants: passable for honest newcomers, too cramped for clones.
